name: mainbg-r1
note: 메인(정원) 배경 후보 R1 (Lucy 2026-11-22: 메인은 반드시 움직이는 배경). 타이틀 겸 메인 화면에 깔리고 왼쪽 3분의 1에 세로 메뉴가 떠요(0054). 정원 = 들 한가운데 울타리를 두른 조율사의 집(05-world). 사람 · 화자 없음(0031). 나중에 레이어로 나눠 리깅하니, 움직일 것(나무 잎, 풀, 널린 천, 굴뚝 연기, 등불, 바람개비, 구름)이 서로 겹치지 않고 윤곽이 또렷해야 해요. 왼쪽 3분의 1은 조용하고 어둡게, 가운데 아래는 정령이 설 수 있는 평평한 빈 마당.
style_block: 1.4::artist:wanke ::, 0.3::artist:kidmo ::, 1.5::artist:ask (askzy) ::, 0.7::artist:freng ::, 0.7::artist:ratatatat74 ::, 0.8::artist:ningen mame::, artist: kim hyung tae , artist:kedama milk, artist:clioranko, year 2024, year 2025
common_prompt: no humans, scenery, outdoors, wide shot, 1.2::slightly high eye level view::, 1.4::the left third of the image is calm, plain and darker, only open meadow and sky there::, 1.3::the main subject sits in the right half of the image::, 1.2::a flat open empty yard of short grass in the lower middle::, 1.2::separate clear shapes with clean silhouettes, few overlapping objects::, 1.2::painterly background art, soft brushwork, simplified shapes, muted colors, no lineart::, game cg, atmospheric perspective
tail: location, very aesthetic, masterpiece, no text

uc_preset_note: Heavy 프리셋에서 'negative space, blank page'를 뺌

types.label: 울타리 두른 집, 맑은 낮
types.why: 세계 문서의 정원 그대로예요. 가장 기본.
types.prompt: 1.2::a small cozy cottage with a low wooden fence in the middle of a wide meadow on a clear day::, one big old tree beside the cottage, a thin line of smoke from the chimney, a clothesline with a few plain cloths, a small wooden pinwheel on the fence, drifting clouds, soft daylight, fresh green, warm straw, pale sky blue, weathered wood color palette

types.label: 울타리 두른 집, 해 질 녘 등불
types.why: 돌아오는 곳의 느낌. 등불 깜빡임과 창 불빛이 움직임이 돼요.
types.prompt: 1.2::a small cozy cottage with a low wooden fence in the middle of a wide meadow at dusk::, warm light in the window, paper lanterns hanging on the fence and under the eaves, one big old tree beside the cottage, a thin line of smoke from the chimney, first stars, afterglow on the horizon, deep teal, warm amber, dusty rose, dark wood color palette

types.label: 큰 나무 아래 쉼터
types.why: 집보다 나무가 주인공. 잎과 매단 천이 크게 흔들려요.
types.prompt: 1.2::a huge old tree on a low rise in a wide meadow, a tiny hut and a low wooden fence under it::, long plain cloth strips and small charms hanging from the branches, a hammock, tall grass at the edges, drifting clouds, soft late afternoon light, moss green, warm straw, faded indigo cloth, pale gold color palette

types.label: 언덕 위 정원, 멀리 들이 겹겹
types.why: 들이 정원에서 멀어질수록 다른 땅으로 이어지는 세계가 보여요. 먼 풍경 시차가 커요.
types.prompt: 1.2::a small fenced cottage garden on a gentle hill overlooking layered distant fields and far hills::, a winding path leading away, one tree and a small wooden windmill beside the cottage, a thin line of chimney smoke, big slow clouds, morning light, soft sage green, pale gold, misty blue distance color palette

types.label: 밤의 정원, 별과 반딧불
types.why: 메뉴 글자가 가장 잘 읽히는 어두운 판. 반딧불과 별이 움직임이 돼요.
types.prompt: 1.2::a small cozy cottage with a low wooden fence in a wide meadow at night under a starry sky::, warm light in the window, one lantern by the gate, one big old tree beside the cottage, fireflies over the grass, a thin line of chimney smoke, deep night blue, warm amber window light, dark green color palette

types.label: 가까이 본 안뜰
types.why: 집 전체가 아니라 마당 안. 정령이 설 자리가 넓어 출전 준비 · 깃들기와 같이 쓰기 좋아요.
types.prompt: 1.2::inside a small fenced cottage yard, the corner of a wooden cottage with a porch at the right edge, a wooden gate and low fence in the back::, a clothesline with a few plain cloths, a stone well, potted herbs, a small pinwheel, a big tree branch reaching in from the top right, open meadow beyond the fence, soft afternoon light, warm straw, fresh green, weathered wood, pale sky color palette

how: 프롬프트 = style_block + ', ' + common_prompt + ', ' + type.prompt + ', ' + tail. 타입마다 씨앗 6개, 모두 36장. 원본 PNG는 stage-bg/main-bg/r1/<타입 앞 두 글자>-s<씨앗>-raw.png.
